0_MasterExecutionPipeline.purpose: Instructs the trading script on the exact chronological and hierarchical loop required to analyze a chart from its absolute origin to the live real-time price.

Phase_1_Origin_Initialization.action: Fetch maximum historical data on the highest timeframe (Monthly or 3-Month).
Phase_1_Origin_Initialization.step_1: Locate the absolute all-time lowest price (for bull markets) or highest price (for bear markets). This is 'Point Zero'.
Phase_1_Origin_Initialization.step_2: Anchor the Grand Supercycle [I] or Supercycle ((I)) to this exact date and price.

Phase_2_Macro_Scanning.action: Run SwingPivotDetectionEngine on the highest timeframe using Macro pivot parameters.
Phase_2_Macro_Scanning.step_1: Identify the largest completed swings from Point Zero to the present.
Phase_2_Macro_Scanning.step_2: Apply WaveDecompositionEngine to label these as Parent Waves (e.g., Waves I, II, III, IV, V).
Phase_2_Macro_Scanning.step_3: Lock the exact 'start_date', 'end_date', 'start_price', and 'end_price' for every completed Parent Wave.

Phase_3_Recursive_Drill_Down_Constraint.concept: The Russian Doll Constraint. Lower timeframe data MUST be constrained by the Parent Wave's boundaries.
loop_logic: 1. For every Parent Wave locked in Phase 2, slice the lower timeframe array (e.g., Daily) between the Parent's 'start_date' and 'end_date'.
2. The script is FORBIDDEN from looking outside this time slice when calculating internal subwaves.
3. The starting subwave (e.g., wave 1 or A) MUST start at the Parent's exact 'start_price'.
4. The ending subwave (e.g., wave 5 or C) MUST end at the Parent's exact 'end_price'.
Phase_3_Recursive_Drill_Down_Constraint.validation: If the Parent is an Impulse, the script must force the SwingPivotDetectionEngine to find 5 valid pivots inside that specific time slice. If it cannot find 5 valid pivots that obey Elliott rules, reduce the confidence score of the Parent Wave and flag as 'Unproven Internal Structure'.

top_down_detail_rule_from_video.rule: After the highest timeframe parent is labeled, lower timeframes must only fill in progressively smaller subwaves. They must not create a new parent count that conflicts with the higher timeframe.

Phase_4_Multi_Timeframe_Cascade.action: Repeat Phase 3 recursively down the timeframes.
Phase_4_Multi_Timeframe_Cascade.termination: Stop historical recursion when you reach the 1H timeframe to save compute power, unless the parent wave is unusually short.

video_degree_sequence.rule: Start from the highest practical timeframe, then zoom in. The 1H chart is a street map; weekly is the world map. Never analyze the 1H in isolation.

Phase_5_Live_Edge_Processing.action: Analyze the active, uncompleted wave using real-time TradingView data.
Phase_5_Live_Edge_Processing.step_1: Identify the last locked macro pivot (e.g., the start of current Wave 5).
Phase_5_Live_Edge_Processing.step_2: Use 1H and 15m live data streams to track the active subwaves forming in real-time.
Phase_5_Live_Edge_Processing.step_3: Run WaveMeasurementEngine to project Fibonacci targets for the live price action.
Phase_5_Live_Edge_Processing.step_4: Constantly check MACD momentum and signal-line behavior on the live 1H/15m chart as supporting evidence for wave termination.

map_vs_execution_warning.rule: A projected Elliott path is a probability map, not a complete trading system. Live entries require execution triggers, stop location, and position sizing.

Phase_2A_Degree_Reading_Gate.purpose: Prevent the AI from mixing wave degrees or forcing labels before the chart context is understood.
Phase_2A_Degree_Reading_Gate.action: Before interpreting any Elliott label, identify the same-degree labels first, then identify the largest visible degree structure, then drill downward.
rules: Read same-degree labels together. Do not connect or compare labels from different degrees as if they belong to the same cycle.
Largest visible degree controls the chart interpretation. Smaller labels are subwaves/details inside that parent.
A lower timeframe is only a zoomed-in version of the higher timeframe parent. It must tie back to the same parent anchors and connectors.

If a chart starts after the true historical origin and the left side is unavailable, the AI may set a provisional local zero, but must mark the count as local-context only until higher history is checked.

Phase_2B_Main_Connector_Identification.purpose: Find the main corrective connectors that define direction and targets before filling in subwaves.
Phase_2B_Main_Connector_Identification.main_connectors: In corrective structures, the major W/X or A/B pivots are the connectors that define whether the next expected leg is Y or C.
rules: Identify the main trend first when possible using higher highs/higher lows or lower lows/lower highs.
Identify the main connectors next; they often appear around the largest trendline break or the largest same-degree corrective pivot.
Use equal-leg Fibonacci extension from W to X to project a likely Y target, commonly near 100% of W, with 61.8% as an incomplete/shallower relationship.
Do not set precise trade entries from the map alone; entries require a separate execution layer and risk plan.

definitions.swing_high: A price bar/candle with a high that is strictly greater than the highs of the preceding and succeeding bars.
definitions.swing_low: A price bar/candle with a low that is strictly lower than the lows of the preceding and succeeding bars.

rules: Pivot strength increases with distance, volume reaction, MACD reaction, Fibonacci reaction, and timeframe agreement.
A swing low must have higher lows before and after it.
Pivot strength increases with distance, volume reaction, RSI reaction, Fib reaction, and timeframe agreement.

noise_filtering: Ignore pivots smaller than ATR threshold.
Detect candidate pivots from price and time before reading MACD, volume, EWO, or Fibonacci evidence.
Indicators may rank or confirm a price pivot, but must not create, erase, or preselect the pivot during the blind recount pass.
multi_timeframe_confirmation: Lower-timeframe pivots are only used to subdivide higher-timeframe waves.

2A_WaveBoundaryIndicatorAudit.purpose: Prevent indicator cherry-picking and false Wave 3/Wave 5 divergence claims.
rules: Lock candidate pivots from price before reading RSI, volume, MACD, or EWO.
Use the same timeframe, data session, price adjustment basis, and wave boundaries for every comparison.
Compare endpoint-to-endpoint and within-wave-extreme-to-within-wave-extreme separately; never mix those measurement types.
If Wave 5 RSI is higher than Wave 3 RSI, record No RSI Divergence and remove RSI exhaustion as confirmation.
Higher Wave 5 RSI is not a classical invalidation; test an extended fifth, nested 1-2 structure, and degree reassignment before accepting the count.
Indicators rank structurally valid counts but cannot replace Elliott price rules or required internal subdivisions.
Every indicator claim must report timeframe, pivot dates and prices, and whether endpoint or within-wave extremes were compared.

The first defensible completed Intermediate Wave (1) candidate ends at 63.90 on 8 April 2024, pending lower-timeframe subdivision verification.

calculations.arithmetic_rule: Use for short-term/intraday charts where price variation is less than 50%.
calculations.logarithmic_percentage_rule: MANDATORY for macro charts spanning > 2 years or > 100% price growth. Fibs must be calculated based on percentage growth, not raw points. (e.g., Wave 3 percentage growth = Wave 1 percentage growth * 1.618).

3_WaveMeasurementEngine.fib_rejection_logic: Reject extensions > 4.236. If an extension > 4.236 is found, the wave degrees are mismatched. The 'Wave 1' is actually a micro subwave, and the 'Wave 3' is a macro wave. Recalculate anchors.

assignment_rules.Cycle: 1 to 3+ year trends. Notation: I, II, III, IV, V.

timeframe_visibility_guidelines_from_vid.Grand_Supercycle_Supercycle_Cycle: Mostly visible on Weekly and Daily charts.
timeframe_visibility_guidelines_from_vid.Primary_Intermediate_Minor: Mostly visible on Daily and 4H charts.
timeframe_visibility_guidelines_from_vid.rule: These are visibility guidelines, not hard limits. The AI must still obey parent boundaries and actual pivot scale.

rules: Treat the degree table as a dictionary for reading the chart.
Identify labels of the same degree first before deciding structure.
If two labels share the same degree, they are part of the same cycle unless a higher-degree boundary invalidates that interpretation.
If a label degree is unknown, mark it unknown instead of mixing it with nearby labels.

validation_rules: Wave 2 can never retrace 100% of Wave 1.
Wave 3 can never be the shortest motive wave.
Wave 4 can never overlap the price territory of Wave 1 (except in diagonals).
Wave 4 does not pass 50% Fibonacci retracement of Wave 3 (unless a diagonal).
Do not force a 1-2-3-4-5 impulse label when the movement is overlapping, equal-legged, or internally corrective.
An impulse must have five-wave subdivisions inside Waves 1, 3, and 5. If W1/W3/W5 internal subdivisions are not five-wave structures, reject the impulse label.
A corrective trend can keep progressing in repeated three-wave structures; label it WXY or related corrective combinations instead of forcing impulse labels.
If the chart does not show 5-3-5 internally, do not label the correction as a zigzag ABC.

impulse_vs_corrective_decision_rules_fro.impulse_character: Clear, strong directional movement with limited overlap; Waves 1, 3, and 5 subdivide into five waves; Wave 3 is commonly the strongest/longest.
impulse_vs_corrective_decision_rules_fro.corrective_character: Overlapping movement, equal legs, repeated 3-wave advances/declines, and frequent WXY structures.
impulse_vs_corrective_decision_rules_fro.decision: When evidence conflicts, prefer corrective labeling over forced impulse labeling until a valid internal five-wave structure is proven.

expected_behavior.Wave_1: Volume might increase a bit, but not enough to alert many analysts.
expected_behavior.Wave_2: Strict, visible contraction confirming retail profit-taking over distribution. Lower than Wave 1.
expected_behavior.Wave_3: Explosive, highest sustained volume of the cycle. Crowd joins the trend.
expected_behavior.Wave_5: Volume expansion on breakout, but critically lower total volume than Wave 3.
expected_behavior.Corrections: Spikes on capitulation (Wave C), dries up on trap rallies (Wave B).

data_contract.consistency_rule: Use one and only one volume metric for all compared waves in a sequence. Never compare total volume for one wave with average volume for another wave.
data_contract.corporate_action_rule: Volumes and prices must be adjusted consistently for splits, symbol conversions, exchange changes, and other corporate actions before verification. If they are not comparable, return Insufficient Data.

Rule_1_Wave_3_Strength_Check.warning: If Volume(Wave 3) < Volume(Wave 1), set Warning: Weak Wave 3.
Rule_1_Wave_3_Strength_Check.warning_lowest: If Wave 3 has strictly lower volume than Waves 1 and 5, set Warning: Wave 3 weakest in supporting volume evidence.
Rule_1_Wave_3_Strength_Check.interpretation_boundary: Volume can warn or rank but cannot invalidate an otherwise rule-valid Elliott count. The classical hard rule is that Wave 3 cannot be the shortest actionary wave by price movement and must travel beyond Wave 1.

Rule_2_Correction_Dry_Up_Check.passed: If Volume(Wave 2) < Volume(Wave 1) and Volume(Wave 4) < Volume(Wave 3), set Passed: Healthy Correction unless a higher-priority status applies.
Rule_2_Correction_Dry_Up_Check.warning: If Volume(Wave 2) > Volume(Wave 1) or Volume(Wave 4) > Volume(Wave 3), set Warning: High selling volume on pullback unless Invalid applies.
Rule_2_Correction_Dry_Up_Check.equality_rule: Equal volumes neither pass the strict dry-up test nor count as a spike. Record the equality in volume_notes.

Rule_3_Wave_5_Exhaustion_Check.valid: If EndPrice(Wave 5) > EndPrice(Wave 3) and Volume(Wave 5) < Volume(Wave 3), set Valid: Wave 5 Volume Divergence Confirmed (Reversal Imminent).
Rule_3_Wave_5_Exhaustion_Check.signal_boundary: The status text is retained for compatibility with the requested workflow, but volume divergence alone cannot prove reversal timing. Require completed Wave 5 structure, RSI divergence, price confirmation, and invalidation before any execution signal.

status_precedence: Valid: Wave 5 Volume Divergence Confirmed (Reversal Imminent)
Warning: High selling volume on pullback
sequence_verification_rules.active_sequence_rule: Evaluate every rule whose required waves are complete. Missing future Waves 4 or 5 must be recorded in volume_notes and prevents a final no-warning pass, but an already-observed warning or invalidation must still be reported.

rules: Impulse channel connects Wave 1 and Wave 3, then projects from Wave 2.
Corrective channel connects A and C, with parallel from B.
Triangle uses A-C and B-D trendlines.

9_PatternRankingEngine.usage_boundary: Ranking weights are only diagnostic/tie-break inputs. They must not override the Strict Verification Gate or create a confidence-score acceptance.

Impulse.Rules: W2 < 100% of W1. W3 not shortest. W4 does not overlap W1.
Impulse.Personality: W1 rarely obvious. W3 is powerful and unmistakable. W5 driven by universal retail bullishness.

Ending_Diagonal.Rules: Occurs in Wave 5 or C. Trendlines converge. W4 MUST overlap W1.

Zigzag.Rules: Wave B < 100% of A. Wave C goes beyond A.
Zigzag.Fibonacci_guidelines_from_video: C is commonly near 100% of A; B normally remains below/above the start of A in the opposite direction and often retraces around the middle of A.
Zigzag.Anti_mislabel_rule_from_video: If the internal structure is not 5-3-5, do not label it as a zigzag ABC.

Expanded_Flat.Rules: Wave B > 100% of A (Bull Trap). Wave C > 100% of A (Liquidation).

Triangle.Rules: Cannot occur in Wave 2. Must be Wave 4, B, X, or Y.

Double_Three_WXY.Rules: W and Y are corrective structures connected by X. W can internally be zigzag, flat, WXY, or another corrective form. X is a connector/countertrend correction.
Double_Three_WXY.Fibonacci_guidelines: Y commonly reaches 100% of W measured from X; 61.8% can be a shallower/incomplete relationship.
Double_Three_WXY.Interpretation: If W and X are accepted at the same degree, expect Y in the same direction as W, often breaking beyond W.

Flat.Rules: A is corrective, B is corrective and can exceed the origin of A, C is five waves and usually retests or marginally breaks the end of A.
Flat.Personality: Sideways/consolidating correction rather than a sharp directional zigzag.

Corrective_Trend_Sequence.Structure: Repeated 3-wave advances/declines, often WXY nested inside larger WXY.
Corrective_Trend_Sequence.Rules: A market can trend in corrective sequences, especially when overlapping/equal-leg swings dominate. This is not automatically an impulse.
Corrective_Trend_Sequence.Use: When repeated equal-leg 3-wave swings persist with overlap, classify the trend as corrective until a clean impulse proves otherwise.

Human_Analyst_Notes.Identifying_Wave_A: First violent break of the trendline. RSI drops below 40 instantly. Often 5 waves down.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Identifying_Wave_B: Low volume, choppy rally. Looks like the trend is resuming but RSI fails to cross 60. A trap.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Confirming_Triangles: Look for 5 swings. If it breaks out on swing 4, it's NOT a triangle. Volume must dry up to almost zero before breakout.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Using_RSI_Divergence: Divergence between W3 and W5 supports termination but is not a classical price-rule requirement. If W5 RSI is higher than W3 RSI, retain the extending-W3 alternate and require stronger structural proof before accepting W5.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Degree_Dictionary_First: Before reading a chart, identify the wave degree dictionary/notation. Same-degree labels define the cycle; smaller degrees are only subwaves.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Do_Not_Force_Impulse: If price action is overlapping and legs are roughly equal, reject impulse labeling unless Waves 1, 3, and 5 can be proven internally as five-wave structures.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Main_Connectors: In corrective structures, W/X or A/B are the main connectors. Once accepted, the expected next leg is Y or C, commonly toward an equal-leg area.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Label_From_Top_Down: Label the highest timeframe first. Lower timeframes only add subwave detail and must tie back to the parent labels.
Human_Analyst_Notes.Elliott_Map_Not_Execution: Elliott Wave gives probable path/direction. Entries require a separate trading execution system and risk management.

13_MultiDegreeValidationEngine.Core_Principle: A wave cannot be accepted as valid until its internal structure has been validated.

Subwave_Consistency_Rule.Impulse: Engine MUST output the 5 internal subwaves: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
Subwave_Consistency_Rule.Zigzag: Engine MUST output the 5-3-5 internal subwaves.
Subwave_Consistency_Rule.Flat: Engine MUST output the 3-3-5 internal subwaves.
Subwave_Consistency_Rule.Triangle: Engine MUST output the A-B-C-D-E internal subwaves.

13_MultiDegreeValidationEngine.Strict_Verification_Gate: Reject a count that breaks mandatory Elliott price rules or required internal structure. MACD, normalized EWO, volume, Fibonacci, and duration rank otherwise valid counts; disagreement must be reported rather than converted into false mathematical certainty.

Same_Degree_Consistency_Rule.rule: A count is invalid if labels of different degrees are interpreted as the same cycle or if same-degree anchors do not tie across Weekly, Daily, 4H, and 1H.

Top_Down_Tie_Up_Rule.rule: Daily must be a zoomed-in version of Weekly, 4H must be a zoomed-in version of Daily, and 1H must be a zoomed-in version of 4H. If the lower timeframe creates different anchors, reject or mark Unproven Internal Structure.

14_TradeExecutionBoundaryLayer.principle: Elliott Wave analysis is a map of probable path, not a complete trading system.
requirements_before_trade_signal: Directional map from Elliott wave degree and structure.
Separate execution trigger such as 3/7/11 swing setup, breakout/retest, or other defined entry model.
Logical invalidation/stop location based on wave structure.
Position sizing and risk management before entry.
Multi-timeframe agreement so the lower timeframe trade is not against the higher timeframe map.
14_TradeExecutionBoundaryLayer.prohibition: Do not produce a trade entry solely because an Elliott path points up or down.

15_KnowledgeSources.title: What's the SECRET to Accurately Labeling ELLIOTT WAVE Charts?
integration_summary: Strengthened top-down Elliott wave degree reading.
Added same-degree-only label interpretation before structure decisions.
Added anti-forcing rule: do not label an impulse when price action is overlapping/equal-leg corrective movement.
Added WXY/double-three corrective logic and equal-leg target behavior.
Added trading-boundary rule: Elliott wave chart is a map, not a standalone trade-entry system.

EWO_CalculationLayer.ewo: SMA(5, Median Price) - SMA(35, Median Price)
EWO_CalculationLayer.aggregation_rule: Only completed waves are aggregated; wave_ewo_peak is max(abs(EWO)) inside inclusive parent dates.

ImpulseVerificationEngine.wave_3_strength: Wave 3 cumulative volume and abs EWO peak commonly exceed Wave 1. Weakness in either dimension is supporting-evidence warning only and is not a classical invalidation.
ImpulseVerificationEngine.correction_reset: W2 volume < W1, W4 volume < W3, and Wave 4 EWO range must touch/cross zero.
ImpulseVerificationEngine.wave_5_divergence: A new Wave 5 price extreme requires both cumulative volume and abs EWO peak below Wave 3.
ImpulseVerificationEngine.signal_boundary: Reversal Imminent is a compatibility label, not standalone trade timing; require structure, price confirmation, invalidation, and risk controls.

EarlyLeg1CorrectionClassifier.confidence_score: Winning points divided by all awarded points; unavailable tests award no points.

ForensicCorrectionForecaster.three_subwaves_shallow_leg_2: Below 90% selects W-X-Y with Y near equality to W.
ForensicCorrectionForecaster.triple_three: A second shallow connector on low volume selects W-X-Y-X-Z and final Wave Z.

17_BlindRecountCanonicalSelectionEngine.source: RKLB blind recount selected by user as canonical method on 2026-07-15
17_BlindRecountCanonicalSelectionEngine.scope: Mandatory default for stocks, commodities, crypto, indices, and other charts before assigning a canonical Elliott hierarchy.
17_BlindRecountCanonicalSelectionEngine.core_principle: Confirmed swings are discovered before Elliott degrees are assigned. A targeted test of preselected pivots can verify that the pivots exist, but cannot prove that their degree labels are correct.
chronological_process: Fetch the maximum reliable history and begin on the highest practical timeframe.
Detect major price pivots blindly from price, time, and volatility without consulting the proposed Elliott labels.
Compress nearby duplicate pivots and identify complete motive-correction-motive blocks before naming degrees.
Generate at least two price-valid high-degree candidate counts whenever ambiguity exists.
Apply mandatory Elliott price rules and reject candidates that fail them.
Open every proposed impulse and correction on lower timeframes to verify its required internal structure.
Compare logarithmic price proportion, duration proportion, alternation, Fibonacci relationships, and parent-child boundary consistency.
Only after structural testing, use MACD, normalized EWO, comparable normalized volume, channels, and volatility as confirmation or contradiction.
Run causal replay separately to test when pivots became knowable. Never treat a causal pivot score as proof of degree assignment.
Promote one count to canonical only when its advantages over the alternates are written explicitly. Preserve every still-price-valid alternate with its invalidation level.
candidate_ranking_order: Clean separation of complete motive and corrective structures.
Logarithmic price and time proportionality at the proposed degree.
MACD, normalized EWO, normalized/comparable volume, channel, and volatility confirmation.
Parsimony: prefer the count requiring fewer forced subdivisions, truncations, degree jumps, or unexplained overlaps.

indicator_normalization.EWO: For cross-wave comparisons over large price changes, compare EWO as a percentage of median price as well as raw EWO. Raw EWO alone is scale-biased.
indicator_normalization.Volume: Use average or relative volume on a comparable session, timeframe, and corporate-action basis. Cumulative volume alone is duration-biased.
indicator_normalization.Bond_yields_and_macro: Macro data may corroborate maturity or risk regime but cannot determine Elliott degree or validate a wave by itself.

canonical_governance.one_canonical_count: Each symbol has one explicitly marked canonical hierarchy.
canonical_governance.alternate_protection: Alternate scripts and reports must write to alternate-named files and are forbidden from overwriting the canonical record.
canonical_governance.revision_gate: A canonical count may change only after a new blind recount documents what new price evidence invalidated or materially weakened the previous count.
canonical_governance.user_selected_preference: When the user explicitly selects one price-valid count as the working model, retain it as canonical until invalidation or a later requested blind recount.
canonical_governance.live_edge: New live lows/highs update the active wave endpoint but do not silently rewrite completed higher-degree waves.

required_output: Data source, history depth, session basis, adjustment basis, and logarithmic/arithmetic mode.
Preferred hierarchy from highest defensible degree to the lowest useful active degree.
Internal subdivisions for every completed parent used to justify the count.
Mandatory-rule results separated from supporting indicator evidence.
At least one alternate when degree ambiguity remains, with strengths, weaknesses, confirmation, and invalidation.
Current confirmation levels, invalidation levels, and a statement that the wave map is not a standalone trade entry.
17_BlindRecountCanonicalSelectionEngine.uncertainty_rule: Confidence in the observed swing structure may be higher than confidence in the exact degree names. Report that distinction explicitly.

18_NestedOneTwoExtensionEngine.source: User-requested 1-2 nesting upgrade integrated 2026-07-15; aligned with Elliott Wave International extension guidance
18_NestedOneTwoExtensionEngine.purpose: Prevent a vertical third-of-a-third advance from being mislabeled as an abnormally extended Wave 5.
18_NestedOneTwoExtensionEngine.trigger: Run this engine whenever a proposed Wave 5 is unusually large, terminal divergence is weak or absent, or the chart contains repeated motive advances followed by corrective pullbacks that hold above their corresponding origins.
outside_in_labeling_process: Identify the largest valid Wave 1 and its corrective Wave 2 without using the later vertical advance to choose the labels.
Inside the expected Wave 3, search for a smaller-degree Wave 1 and Wave 2 pair.
Repeat recursively while every smaller Wave 1 is motive, every smaller Wave 2 is corrective, and every Wave 2 stays above the origin of its corresponding Wave 1 in a bull sequence.
After the final nested Wave 2, classify the accelerating advance as a possible third-of-a-third-of-a-third rather than defaulting to Wave 5.
Require the vertical advance itself to subdivide as a valid five-wave impulse before declaring its lower-degree Wave 3 complete.
After a nested third wave completes, expect the stack to unwind through corresponding Wave 4 and Wave 5 pairs from the smallest degree outward.
mandatory_rules: Every proposed Wave 1 must subdivide as a motive five or an allowed leading diagonal.
Every proposed Wave 2 must be corrective and may not retrace beyond the origin of its corresponding Wave 1.
Degree labels must be strictly nested inside their parent dates and price boundaries.
The eventual Wave 3 at each degree may not be the shortest actionary wave.
A later Wave 4 must not overlap Wave 1 territory at its own degree, except in a valid diagonal.
Do not interpret repeated overlapping three-wave movements as nested 1-2s; preserve W-X-Y or other corrective alternates until motive internals are proven.

confirmation_profile.price: Each successive second-wave low remains above the origin of its same-degree first wave, creating an invalidation ladder.
confirmation_profile.momentum: MACD and normalized EWO should generally expand as nested third waves activate; the strongest momentum often occurs in the third of the third rather than at a terminal fifth.
confirmation_profile.volume: Comparable normalized volume should expand during third-wave acceleration and contract during nested second-wave pullbacks.
confirmation_profile.geometry: Acceleration and increasingly steep channels support nesting; deceleration, channel throw-over, and terminal divergence support a fifth-wave interpretation.
confirmation_profile.fibonacci: Wave 2 commonly retraces 38.2%-78.6% of Wave 1. Similar first-wave log amplitudes across degrees can support, but do not prove, nesting.

extended_fifth_comparison_gate: Always compare the nested 1-2 interpretation against the extended-fifth interpretation when a proposed fifth dominates the chart.
Prefer nesting when the supposed earlier Wave 3 is itself a complete smaller impulse followed by a corrective low that stays above its origin and momentum subsequently accelerates.

Prefer an extended fifth when Waves 1 and 3 are comparable, the fourth wave is clearly complete at the same degree, and the final surge shows terminal characteristics or a fifth-within-fifth structure.
If both counts remain price-valid, retain both and state the exact level or future subdivision that separates them.
18_NestedOneTwoExtensionEngine.invalidation_ladder: Store the origin of every nested Wave 1 and the top of every same-degree Wave 1 relevant to future Wave 4 overlap. A break invalidates only that nesting level first; do not automatically invalidate every higher-degree bullish count.
18_NestedOneTwoExtensionEngine.output_requirement: Reports must display nested pairs as an indented hierarchy and list which Wave 4/5 sequences remain ahead at each degree.

19_RecursiveMultiTimeframeEWONesting.source: User-provided recursive multi-timeframe EWO nesting addendum
19_RecursiveMultiTimeframeEWONesting.purpose: Require parent-child Elliott validation through isolated lower-timeframe EWO analysis.
workflow: Establish the parent wave on the highest requested timeframe before assigning child degrees.
Isolate the exact parent start and end dates/prices before downshifting.
Prefer a next timeframe that shows approximately 100-140 bars for readable indicator sensitivity, but treat this as a sampling heuristic that cannot assign degree or override price form.
Run EWO only on the isolated child segment and identify internal Wave 3 peak, Wave 4 zero-line pullback, and Wave 5 divergence.
Repeat recursively for deeper degrees while preserving parent boundaries.
19_RecursiveMultiTimeframeEWONesting.nesting_formula_check: Every completed five-wave child sequence must fit completely inside the exact start/end boundaries of its parent wave.
19_RecursiveMultiTimeframeEWONesting.conflict_rule: If EWO suggests only three swings inside a proposed parent impulse, issue a structural-audit warning and recount the underlying price subdivisions. Reject or relabel the parent only if price form also fails to produce an allowed motive structure.
19_RecursiveMultiTimeframeEWONesting.validation_boundary: EWO is supporting evidence; parent-child price structure and mandatory Elliott rules remain required.

20_ObjectiveScenarioAndRiskGuardrails.core_role: Elliott Wave is a framework for analysing market psychology, trend context, and risk across several possible outcomes. It is not a standalone trading system and must not be presented as deterministic prediction.
20_ObjectiveScenarioAndRiskGuardrails.visual_count_rejection: Never approve a wave count merely because its pivots visually resemble a familiar Elliott pattern. Price rules and required internal structure come first; Fibonacci retracements, extensions, and wave-to-wave relationships must then be measured explicitly.
scenario_requirements: Publish a preferred count and preserve every materially plausible price-valid alternate.
For each scenario, state its confirmation level, invalidation level, expected structural path, and the evidence that would promote or demote it.
Use Elliott Wave to define context and risk boundaries; require a separate execution trigger, stop logic, and position sizing before proposing a trade.
Express uncertainty directly. Confidence in observed pivots may be higher than confidence in exact wave degree or corrective-family labels.

fibonacci_objectivity_gate.impulses: Measure Wave 3 and Wave 5 extensions against Wave 1 and the prior net advance; compare all valid relationships instead of forcing one textbook ratio.
fibonacci_objectivity_gate.corrections: Measure retracement depth and equality or extension relationships among A-B-C or W-X-Y legs before selecting the corrective family.
fibonacci_objectivity_gate.decision_rule: Fibonacci supports and ranks price-valid structures but cannot rescue a count that violates mandatory Elliott rules or fails lower-timeframe subdivision.

20_ObjectiveScenarioAndRiskGuardrails.integration_note: This source reinforces the existing TradeExecutionBoundaryLayer and canonical alternate-count governance. The newly explicit addition is the prohibition on unaided visual counting and the mandatory scenario-by-scenario Fibonacci objectivity gate.

source.title: Elliott Wave Principle / Comprehensive Course
source.role: Primary classical reference for rule-versus-guideline classification

21_FrostPrechterClassicalReference.precedence: Mandatory price rules and required wave form override every indicator, duration table, Fibonacci target, channel, personality observation, or confidence score.
mandatory_motive_rules: Wave 2 may not retrace beyond the origin of Wave 1.
Wave 3 must travel beyond the end of Wave 1.
Wave 3 may not be the shortest of actionary Waves 1, 3, and 5 when compared in percentage terms for large waves and normally also arithmetic terms for smaller waves.
Wave 4 may not retrace beyond the end of Wave 3.
In a cash-market impulse, Wave 4 may not enter Wave 1 price territory.
Impulse actionary subwaves 1, 3, and 5 are motive, and Wave 3 is specifically an impulse.

pattern_dictionary.ending_diagonal: 3-3-3-3-3 wedge, mainly in Wave 5 or C; Wave 1/4 overlap is expected; terminal structure.
pattern_dictionary.leading_diagonal: 5-3-5-3-5 wedge under this reference, only in Wave 1 or A; distinguish from nested 1-2 by slowing fifth-wave speed versus accelerating nested thirds.
pattern_dictionary.zigzag: A-B-C = 5-3-5; sharp; common in Wave 2; C commonly equals A and may be 0.618 or 1.618 times A.
pattern_dictionary.flat: A-B-C = 3-3-5; regular, expanded, or rare running variation.
pattern_dictionary.triangle: A-B-C-D-E = 3-3-3-3-3; contracting or expanding; volume and volatility usually contract; occurs in Wave 4, B, X, or final Y position, not Wave 2.
pattern_dictionary.double_or_triple_zigzag: W-X-Y or W-X-Y-X-Z; directional correction used when the first zigzag does not achieve adequate retracement.
pattern_dictionary.combination: W-X-Y or W-X-Y-X-Z; sideways duration extension; no more than one zigzag and one triangle, with a triangle only final.

correction_rules: A complete correction is never a five; an initial five against the larger trend is only part of the correction.
Every B, D, and X wave is corrective.
Use orthodox pattern endpoints rather than intra-pattern extremes for labeling and ratio measurement.
Running flats are rare and must never be selected prematurely; their internal subdivisions must be proven.

guidelines_not_rules.alternation: Expect Waves 2 and 4 to differ in sharp/sideways form, complexity, depth, or duration, but do not invalidate a count solely for weak alternation.
guidelines_not_rules.extension: Most impulses extend one actionary wave. Stocks most often extend Wave 3; fifth-wave extensions are less common in stocks and more characteristic of commodity bull markets.
guidelines_not_rules.equality: The two non-extended actionary waves tend toward equality in time and magnitude; 0.618 is the next common relation.
guidelines_not_rules.retracement: Sharp corrections often retrace 50%-61.8%; sideways corrections often retrace about 38.2%; these are tendencies only.
guidelines_not_rules.prior_fourth: Corrections, especially fourth waves, often terminate in the territory of the prior fourth wave of one lesser degree.
guidelines_not_rules.channeling: Use parallel channels for targets and structure. Draw 1-3 with a parallel through 2 for Wave 4, then refine with 2-4 and a parallel through 1 for Wave 5.
guidelines_not_rules.volume: Volume verifies and can project extensions but does not invalidate price-valid form. Below Primary degree, normal fifth-wave volume often trails Wave 3; equal/higher volume can indicate a fifth extension. At Primary degree and above, fifth-wave volume may naturally exceed Wave 3.
guidelines_not_rules.momentum_indicators: MACD, EWO, and RSI are modern supporting tools, not classical Elliott rules. RSI remains disabled by default in the legacy profile and is optional soft evidence in the adaptive elliott_full profile.

degree_and_time.rule: Wave degree is not based on fixed price or time lengths. It is determined by form, relative size, and position among component, adjacent, and encompassing waves.
degree_and_time.duration_tables: User-provided duration ranges are retained only as soft priors and anomaly flags; they cannot assign or invalidate degree.
degree_and_time.time_fibonacci: Time ratios are less common and less reliable than price amplitude relationships.

scale_policy.rule: Maintain both arithmetic and semilogarithmic charts.
scale_policy.large_degree: Above Intermediate degree, compare price relationships primarily in percentage terms.
scale_policy.small_degree: At Intermediate degree and below, arithmetic equality is often usable because percentage and point lengths are closer.
scale_policy.channel_selection: If a parallel channel is incoherent on one scale, inspect the other. Report which scale supports the channel and preserve conflicts.

analysis_governance: Wave form analysis precedes Fibonacci ratio analysis.
Indicators and guidelines rank only counts that already satisfy mandatory rules and allowed internal form.
Preserve preferred and alternate rule-valid counts with exact confirmation and invalidation levels.
Report structural confidence separately from exact-degree confidence.

22_AdaptivePreFreezeRecount.purpose: Build independent price-first Primary and Alternative hypotheses, acquire only structurally useful native resolutions, and prove subdivisions before the authoritative technical freeze.
22_AdaptivePreFreezeRecount.activation: Opt-in adaptive-recount workflow; the legacy analysis path remains available.

timeframe_policy.rule: Select canonical timeframes dynamically from the connected provider's immutable advertised capabilities. Timeframe is evidence granularity, not Elliott degree.
timeframe_policy.sampling_target: Prefer approximately 100-140 useful native bars when practical; this is a view-selection heuristic, never a hard Elliott rule.
timeframe_policy.unsupported_data: Return unsupported, not_covered, budget_exhausted, or unresolved explicitly. Missing data is never evidence against a count.
timeframe_policy.native_boundary: Exact pivots require native completed candles. Derived evidence must remain identified as derived and follow its separately approved policy.

blind_generation: Generate Primary and Alternative in separate calls from the same fresh price evidence and generic rules.
Do not expose either candidate to its peer before both are frozen.
Exclude prior symbol counts, reports, runs, resolutions, accepted cases, forecasts, outcomes, lessons, targets, invalidations, overlays, fundamentals, news and events.
Reject an Alternative that is only a semantic duplicate with renamed identifiers.
recursive_proof: Use typed structural questions and bounded request, bar, graph, pivot, node, depth and terminal-degree policies.
Generate children one degree at a time from a deterministic native pivot catalog.
Only deterministic subdivision validation may return verified, unproven, not_covered or inconsistent.
An active parent cannot be verified as a completed wave, and model prose cannot override proof status.
Preserve structurally valid unresolved alternatives and reject each hypothesis independently.

indicator_profile.name: elliott_full
indicator_profile.governance: Price boundaries and allowed Elliott form come first. Indicator evidence may support, remain neutral, contradict, be unavailable or be incomparable; it cannot create pivots, choose a family or independently invalidate a price-valid count.
indicator_profile.compatibility: RSI remains optional at the lower-level API and legacy feature defaults remain unchanged.

data_governance: Require provider, feed, exchange, session, timezone, adjustment, price basis, timeframe and cutoff provenance.
Do not silently mix providers or compare volume across changed feeds or timeframes.
Store requests, bundles, candidates and proof traces as immutable canonical-hashed artifacts.
22_AdaptivePreFreezeRecount.tradingview_boundary: Codex-controlled MCP ingestion is permitted only when the real TradingView tool supplies provenance-complete raw OHLCV. The currently audited mcp__codex_apps__tradingcursor_request_analysis tool lacks the required raw-candle, completion, session, adjustment and pagination contract, so the workflow must report insufficient capability rather than fabricate access.
22_AdaptivePreFreezeRecount.freeze_boundary: After all surviving branches have explicit proof or bounded-stop states, run the normal final comparison and existing resolve_degrees() deterministic validation. Only that stored result is authoritative; Market Scenario and Phase 11 remain downstream.
